schedule_name: Schedule 01: Procurement of Capital Spares, Assemblies, and Armament Stores

tiers.notes: Full financial powers with MoD (Finance) / IFA concurrence as per Annexure A.
Applicable for Western, Eastern, and Southern Naval Commands.
Requires Command IFA concurrence for amounts exceeding without-IFA threshold.
Exercisable for operational units within designated maritime sector.

tiers.tier_name: Commanding Officer (CO) — Capital Ship (Carrier / Destroyer / Frigate)
tiers.notes: Direct sanction for urgent operational mission replenishment at sea or foreign ports.

tiers.tier_name: Commanding Officer (CO) — Minor War Vessel / Shore Base
tiers.notes: Unit level local purchase and minor repairs under strict accounting ledger.

clauses: 1. Preamble & Applicability: In exercise of the powers conferred by the Government of India, the financial powers contained in Schedule 01 (Procurement of Capital Spares, Assemblies, and Armament Stores) are hereby delegated to the designated Competent Financial Authorities (CFAs) of the Indian Navy.

2. Integrated Financial Concurrence: Sanctions exceeding the 'Without IFA' threshold require the prior formal concurrence of the accredited Integrated Financial Advisor (IFA). Slicing or splitting of indents to evade IFA concurrence is strictly prohibited under Rule 142 of DFPDS-2026.

3. Proprietary Article Certificate (PAC) Sanctions: Procurement on a proprietary basis under PAC shall strictly comply with DPM 2025 Chapter 3 guidelines and cannot exceed the PAC ceiling of 50% of the total delegation tier without explicit Ministry approval.

4. Emergency Replenishment at Sea: Commanding Officers of capital warships on operational deployment outside territorial waters may exercise emergency powers up to 1.5x the normal limit under Category E protocols with post-facto ratification within 30 days.
